description: Install LaTeX (texlive) compilation environment and verify it can compile elsarticle documents. Create the artikel_review_2/ directory structure.
steps: Install texlive packages via dnf: texlive-scheme-full (or sufficient subset including elsarticle, bibtex, fonts, pgfplots, tikz, algorithm, lineno, siunitx, tcolorbox, longtable, booktabs, hyperref, natbib, multirow, caption, float, array, soul, enumitem, geometry, amsmath, graphicx, xcolor)
Verify pdflatex and bibtex are available on PATH
Create a minimal test .tex file using elsarticle class to verify compilation works
Compile the test file and confirm PDF generation succeeds
Remove the test file after verification
acceptance_criteria: pdflatex command is available and functional
bibtex command is available and functional
Directory artikel_review_2/ exists at repository root
A test elsarticle document compiles without errors
findings: texlive-scheme-full installed via dnf. The nss package failed to install through dnf due to an rpm unpacking error, so libnss3.so and libsmime3.so were manually extracted from the nss rpm and placed in /usr/lib64/ to resolve pdflatex shared library dependency. pdflatex is TeX Live 2021 (pdfTeX 3.141592653-2.6-1.40.22), bibtex is 0.99d. Full elsarticle compilation pipeline (pdflatex+bibtex+pdflatex+pdflatex) verified working with all required packages (geometry, lineno, amsmath, graphicx, xcolor, hyperref, natbib, booktabs, longtable, multirow, caption, float, enumitem, soul, siunitx, tikz, pgfplots).
